Then she put the paper in her pocket, climbed the stairs, and polished the lens until it shone.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未写满的纸。路灯还亮着，光圈里浮着薄薄的雾气，柏油路面泛出湿冷的青灰色。环卫车慢慢驶过，水声把落叶推到路牙边。早点铺的卷帘门刚拉起一半，蒸笼的白气挤出来，混着豆浆的甜味。出租车停在十字路口，司机靠在座椅上打盹，仪表盘的绿光映着他的下巴。远处高楼的窗子大多是黑的，只有零星几格亮着，像有人在替整座城市守夜。风从江面吹上来，带着铁锈和水草的气息。这时候的城市不属于白天的任何人，它只是安静地呼吸，等着第一班地铁把喧哗重新载回来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to do the same job — like standing in a long line and asking the person ahead of you \"how many people are in front of you?\" instead of counting everyone yourself.\n- Each copy does one tiny bit of work and passes the rest down, until someone hits the easy case (the first person in line says \"nobody!\"), and then the answers get handed back up the line.\n- You always need that easy stopping case, or the asking never ends — like two mirrors facing each other, reflecting forever."}
